title: Inclusion proof
description: The audit path linking a leaf to a tree head's root (RFC 9162 section 2.1.3), as receipts-log serves it (its API.md). leafIndex must also be less than treeSize, which a schema cannot express; a verifier checks it. Check rootHashHex against a signed tree head, never on its own.

auditPath.description: At most ceil(log2(treeSize)) entries: 53 for a tree of 2^53 - 1 leaves.
